milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia logs are at spawn-relative [10,1,4], approximately 11 blocks from spawn. With max_distance=6, the player must walk at least 5 blocks toward the grove and face it within 60°. This correctly models 'player has navigated to and can see the acacia logs'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia planks wall is at spawn-relative [11,1,6], adjacent to the log grove. With max_distance=6, the player must navigate close and face the planks. This ensures genuine observation rather than accidental triggering from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining a flower (breakable instantly by hand) drops it as an item into the player's inventory. Oxeye daisies are in the flower meadow at x=-5 to -8, z=3-6 west of spawn. The mined item is 'oxeye_daisy'.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted yellow_dye ends up in the player's inventory. The correct recipe is 1 dandelion → 1 yellow_dye (shapeless, craftable in 2x2 inventory grid). Dandelions are co-located with oxeye_daisies in the flower meadow. Player must mine a dandelion then craft it.

Uses inventory_has because mining terracotta with a pickaxe drops the terracotta item into inventory. The player has a wooden pickaxe (sufficient minimum tier). Terracotta wall is at x=-7 to -10, z=-3 to -4, northwest of spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining light_gray_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the item into inventory. Located at x=-7 to -10, z=-5 to -6, directly behind the plain terracotta wall. Requires the provided wooden pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red_sandstone (4 red_sand in 2x2 grid) places the result in inventory. Player must first navigate to the red sand deposit at x=-4 to -6, z=-3 to -6, mine at least 4 blocks (red sand breaks instantly by hand), then craft in the 2x2 inventory grid. No red_sand is given in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia_fence ends up in inventory. This is a multi-step task: player must mine acacia_planks blocks from the grove (need 4 minimum: 2 for fence + 2 for sticks), craft 2 planks into 4 sticks (2x1 vertical in inventory), then use the crafting table at [3,0,0] for the 3x3 fence recipe (stick-plank-stick / stick-plank-stick → 3 fences).
